The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the fully custom construction basis, so no additional or edited Event is needed.
The source focuses the current custom-construction work on the V system and defers construction of the remaining letters; it does not necessarily modify the existing E and L letterform values.
Moving the V system farther from existing typefaces does not change the wordmark's established kerning and cohesive-reading goal, which is separately deferred at this message.
Requesting black-and-white V studies for the current round does not alter the persistent champagne-metal finish requirement or its eventual role in the completed identity.
Allowing the next exploratory round to be less visually finished does not change the requirement for final production-ready artwork.
